data.long_description:
Experience refined living in the prestigious Al Habtoor Polo Resort. This elegant villa offers generous living spaces, sophisticated interiors, and stunning views of the polo fields, creating a unique resort-style lifestyle in one of Dubai’s most exclusive communities.

Designed for families seeking privacy, comfort, and luxury, the property features spacious bedrooms, bright living and dining areas, a modern kitchen, and beautifully landscaped outdoor spaces. Residents enjoy a tranquil environment while remaining conveniently connected to Dubai’s key destinations.

Property Features:

5  Bedrooms
6 Bathrooms
Plot size 6532.83 sqft
Maid’s Room
Large Living & Dining Areas
Modern Kitchen
Private Garden
Covered Parking
Polo Field Views
Gated Community
Resort-Style Lifestyle

Community Highlights:

Exclusive Polo Community
Lush Green Landscapes
Clubhouse & Equestrian Facilities
Family-Friendly Environment
Easy Access to Major Roads
Close to Schools, Retail & Leisure Destinations
Contact us today to arrange a private viewing and discover the exceptional lifestyle offered by Al Habtoor Polo Resort.
